messages:
parth: Quick sync — AWS Marketplace listing needs final security package for partner onboarding. We got their questionnaire + vuln scan. Must provide SOC report (redacted), pen-test evidence or exec summary, signed questionnaire answers, architecture diagram, KMS/HSM attestation, and presigned artifact links. Who owns what?
sarah: I can own SOC2 coordination and questionnaire answers. Need Mike to help with redactions. cc @mike for approvals.
mike: I have SOC2 report (v2, signed 2024-11) in secure S3 but it needs redaction of customer names and some IP. Will generate presigned link. ETA EOD tomorrow.
jenn: Pen-test ask: partner expects a vendor report + remediation evidence. Eng-Infra ran an internal scan; I can produce an exec summary plus links to remediation Jira tickets. Suggest we don't share raw vuln proofs, only summary and ticket IDs.
parth: Partner legal also asked for ATO artifacts (system boundary diagram, scoping doc). They specifically asked for KMS key usage screenshots and confirmation we use HSM-backed keys for certain workloads. @security-bot can you pull the standard architecture diagram?
security-bot: Auto: Generated artifact RDW-arch-v3.svg at s3://redwood-security/artifacts/RDW-arch-v3.svg. To presign run: `artifact-presign --path RDW-arch-v3.svg --ttl 72h`.
sarah: Draft answer to questionnaire Q1: "Do you store customer data unencrypted at rest?" -> "No. We encrypt at rest with AES-256 via customer-separate KMS keys (KMS Key ID: aws:kms:... , control owner: security@redwood)." Will add KMS screenshots.
mike: I'll produce the redacted SOC link once redaction script runs: `python tools/redact_soc.py --input soc2.pdf --output soc2-redacted.pdf --remove_names`. Also assembling a short pen-test summary (1 page) with findings + mitigation status.
jenn: Need to schedule partner security call — their reviewer availability: Thu 09:00-11:00 PT or Fri 13:00-15:00 PT. Who can join?
parth: I can do Thu 09:00 PT. @sarah? @mike?
sarah: Thu 09:00 PT works for me.
mike: I prefer Fri but can try to join Thu 09:00 if necessary.
parth: Action items: mike - produce redacted SOC + presign links; jenn - assemble pen-test exec summary and remediation ticket list; sarah - complete questionnaire answers + attach KMS screenshots + confirm HSM usage; parth - draft one-pager ATO scoping. I'll update the partner tracker after we upload artifacts.
security-bot: Auto: Created ticket SEC-4727 "Marketplace partner evidence package" assigned to @parth, due 2026-03-05.
mike: :thumbsup: I'll upload presigned links to this thread when done.
jenn: Uploading internal scan snippet for context:
```json
{"scan_id":"s-abc123","critical":0,"high":2,"medium":4,"low":12}
```
sarah: Quick legal/Q: for pen-test report sharing — do we provide full CVE details or redact specifics (customer URLs, exploitable POCs)? Legal prefers redacted POCs and customer-specific URLs.
parth: Agree — provide redacted technical details. Offer full disclosure under an NDA and gated SFTP if they need full artifacts.
mike: Note: partner also asked for pen-test vendor accreditations. We have an attestation from SecTest Inc (ISO27001 + CREST) in our repo.
parth: I'll forward SecTest contact info to partners. They also asked for retention policy and data flow retention windows — we have retention doc in s3.
security-bot: Reminder: presigned links default TTL 72h. Set TTL explicitly for partner access window and reissue if they request longer.
mike: Uploaded presigned links (temporary placeholders):
- SOC2 (redacted): https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-sec/soc2-v2-redacted.pdf?sig=AAA (expires in 72h)
- Arch diagram: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-security/artifacts/RDW-arch-v3.svg?sig=BBB (expires in 72h)
- Pen-test summary: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-security/pen-summary.pdf?sig=CCC (expires in 72h)
parth: Thanks — I'll package this and send to partner after the Thu call. We'll ask them to confirm receipt and whether they need NDA for the full pen-test report. Closing loop once partner confirms.
